items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: up to the last I was with him, he's very particular. He likes good rhythm... I don't know how he's doing now, since you see O'Reilly

ctx.x: And that's what O'Reilly made his reputation on. It wasn't so much playing, it was just that rhythm. Yeah, that was wonderful. The people out there just went crazy about it. They couldn't understand how we'd play like that. And O'Reilly used to play so soft. And that was loud.
That's right. I heard him playing so soft. It was real loud.
